verdict.rationale: Jules ships an official REST API (with API keys, task creation, plan approval, messaging endpoints) explicitly intended for building custom workflows and integrations, and one community member confirms building on it (a personal MCP server dispatching tasks via the Jules API). However, there's no evidence of dedicated language SDK libraries (Python/JS/etc.) or a discoverable OpenAPI spec — probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all 404'd.  missing for 10: official client SDK libraries beyond raw REST, published OpenAPI/swagger spec, broader independent corroboration of SDK-based integrations.
